title: Unredaction tools and the failure modes each one is BUILT to find
rationale: A confusion matrix that infers a tool's scope from its results cannot tell a
REGRESSION from a mode the tool was never meant to handle. x-ray scoring zero
on 19 of 20 modes is not 19 false negatives — it is 19 modes outside its stated
scope, and reporting them as misses flatters excise by construction.
So scope is DECLARED here and the matrix reads it. A tool that scores zero on a
mode INSIDE its scope is a real false negative and blocks. A tool that scores a
hit OUTSIDE its declared scope is reported as `beyond-declared-scope` rather
than silently folded in: it means either the tool does more than its
documentation claims, or this file is stale. Both are worth a human look, and

tools.scopeNote: excise claims every registered mode. A zero anywhere is a finding.
recoveryNote: The full ladder. `Recovered` is a READING of bytes with zero residual bits;
`CandidatesOnly` is an INFERENCE carrying a candidate set and a bits figure.
Collapsing those two into 'found it' is what the matrix exists to stop.

scopeNote: x-ray's own README: it supports 'the most basic (and most common) type of
bad redaction, rectangles on top of text'. Read from the source (pdf_utils.py):
get_good_rectangles requires fill_opacity == 1, a fill, >4x4pt, and not in the
top 43pt; get_intersecting_chars requires a char >=80% occluded by a rect drawn
AFTER it (or of the same colour); filter_redactions_by_text then drops repeated
characters, blanks, non-alphanumerics and an OK-word list (redacted/confidential
/privileged).
⚠️ box-inside-form-xobject and box-drawn-by-annotation are DELIBERATELY not
listed even though PyMuPDF might reach them: nothing in x-ray's documentation
claims them. If the matrix reports beyond-declared-scope hits there, measure it
and widen this list on the evidence — do not widen it on a guess.
recoveryNote: x-ray READS characters PyMuPDF already extracted; it never infers. So it has
no partial and no candidate rung, and the matrix must not score it as though
a missing candidate set were a weakness — on its own mode it is exact or
nothing, which is a different shape of answer, not a worse one.

scopeNote: Bland et al., PETS 2023 — the glyph-position side channel, which is the
partial-glyph-removal-kerning mode and the one x-ray cannot see at all.
⚠️ It cannot be graded, and the reason is not that we have not got round to it.
The author deliberately withheld the recovery code: 'Remediation efforts and
questionable legality prevent me from releasing the code publicly to
automatically break redactions', and of the excising directory specifically,
'I had to delete about 80%-90% of the code in this directory'. What ships is a
glyph-positioning library (pts) and a redaction LOCATOR. The repository also
carries no licence at all.
Kept as a row so the absence is recorded rather than rediscovered. If it is
ever wired in, it is as a geometry oracle for the residue channel — a second
opinion on glyph positions, independent of mutool — not as a recoverer.
